summary: Operator + Park With Us read: 51 RV sites (all to 50 ft; 17 pull-through 50 A FHU), 20 primitive tent sites, season May 1-Sep 30, FHU from $48 tax included (passes the $50 gate), showers/laundry/WiFi. 29 of 51 RV sites sell online by the night; with tent sites ~49 of 71 nightly. Google 4.1/145, RV Life 4*/58. Not waterfront stands.
flags: PRICE: cheapest real RV night = full hookup from $48 (tax included, so lower before tax) every season the park opens; summer peak not posted beyond 'starting at'. Park With Us adds an 8% online service fee (guest-paid), ~$51.84 online; phoning avoids it. No gateway within 40 km; not a Good Sam Park (Good Sam lists it as MEMBERSHIP_PARK). Passes the gate on the posted rate.

LONG-STAY: long-term sites marketed (weekly $245, monthly $650); 22 of 51 RV sites (the whole A row and 8 others) are not bookable online - likely the long-term pads. Nightly share ~29 of 51 RV sites (57%), ~49 of 71 counting the 20 tent sites (69%). Passes; no seasonal caveat needed.
MEMBERSHIP: Coast to Coast / RPI / AOR member park that sells memberships, but nights are sold to the public online; no membership required.
RV Life tier stale: price_level 1 (avg $19) vs posted $48; stored rating.price_tier 1 left (rvlife source).
Military discount on the engine (amount not shown) -> discounts.military true; good_sam false (derived) left.
Waterfront: a river/willow bottom lies ~110-140 m south of the south loop through willows; not waterfront stands (no upgrade case).
Phone 307-537-5453 and website confirmed. Pin 42.76010,-109.73470 is ~75 m from the engine's point (42.759721,-109.735504) and inside the park; fine.
